propositions: Partial-clone test fixtures consume 32.69 worker-phase seconds due to >100MiB real repository duplication across xdist workers.
A large >100MiB object contrast guard is required for filter:blob:none negotiation proof and cannot be replaced by config inspection or mocks.
Protocol-negotiation, missing-object, identity, and reconvergence test oracles are size-independent and can use small isolated real-protocol fixtures instead of large repositories.
Shared mutable Git servers across concurrent workers create races and cross-worker contamination; each worker must own isolated ephemeral daemons and temporary repositories.

Replacing large fixtures with small real-protocol fixtures for size-independent tests yields 69.5% wall-time, 78.5% real-time, and 85.2% setup-time savings while retaining real Git protocol coverage for guards that require >140MiB contrast.
